name: quote
sensor: customer request for a fence received
control: only send when fence spec and price are both complete
plan: specify fence, calculate price, compose and send quote
navigate: route between fence and calculation-price until both report done

children.name: fence
children.sensor: customer wishes: length, height, type, gates
children.actuator: record fence spec (length, height, panels, gates)
children.control: check measurements are complete and consistent
children.plan: combine customer wishes with site picture into a buildable spec
children.navigate: ask picture triangle when visual site info is missing

children.name: picture
children.sensor: photo of the yard boundary from customer
children.actuator: annotate measurements and obstacles on the photo
children.control: reject blurry or incomplete photos, request a retake
children.plan: extract boundary length, slope and obstacles from the photo
children.navigate: scan the photo from start post to end post

children.name: calculation-price
children.sensor: BOM totals, labor hours, margin rules
children.actuator: write the price into the quote document
children.control: check price against minimum margin and market range
children.plan: materials cost + labor cost + margin = price
children.navigate: walk the BOM lines and sum costs per category

children.name: BOM
children.goal: list all materials for the fence
children.actuator: emit bill-of-materials lines: posts, panels, concrete, hardware
children.control: verify quantities cover the full length plus 5% waste
children.plan: one post per 2m, panels between posts, concrete per post, hinges per gate
children.navigate: iterate the fence sections from start to end
